test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 2, 24 and 8 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(2, 24, 8) = 24 units.

Combined efficiency = (24 ÷ 2) + (24 ÷ 24) + (24 ÷ 8) = 12 + 1 + 3 = 16 units/day.

Work to be done (twice the same work) = 2 × 24 = 48 units.

Required time = 48 ÷ 16 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**
